nav.title: IPEDS via NCES College Navigator - SF State admissions considerations (fall 2024)

test_policy.notes: SF State's admissions page says the CSU no longer uses ACT/SAT in determining admission eligibility; College Navigator lists SAT/ACT as 'Not considered (Test Blind)'. SAT ERW 550 or ACT English 22 can only be used to show English proficiency.

requirements.notes: Apply through Cal State Apply (not the Common App); $70 fee by credit card or PayPal. For a high school outside the U.S.: 12 years of schooling, eligible for university entry at home, and a 2.5 GPA (B- average) in academic courses after 9th grade; A-G coursework applies to U.S. high school graduates (non-California residents need a 3.0 GPA). Impacted majors are evaluated on supplemental factors. I-20 documents: Financial Affidavit, proof of finances, passport copy. Credential evaluations from third-party companies are not accepted. College Navigator shows essays and recommendations are not considered.

deadlines.label: International application deadline (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Cal State Apply opened Aug 1, 2026; submissions begin Oct 1, 2026. International applicants have until May 1, 2027, but majors may fill: the Nov 30, 2026 priority date applies to impacted majors.

deadlines.label: Application priority deadline for impacted majors
deadlines.notes: Listed on the same table; the international deadline is the later May 1, 2027 date.

deadlines.label: Accept admission offer and pay enrollment confirmation deposit

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required of all undergraduate applicants unless they attended a U.S. high school 3+ years or show 3 years of full-time study in a listed English-instruction country (e.g. Australia, Canada, England, Ireland, New Zealand, Scotland, Wales, South Africa, Jamaica, Kenya, Ghana). Alternatives: SAT ERW 550, ACT English 22, IB English A HL 4, AP English Language or Literature 3. TOEFL Home Edition and IELTS Indicator are accepted.

english.notes: Institutional code 4684. The page does not give a separate score for the new 1-6 TOEFL scale.
IELTS Academic overall; IELTS Indicator overall 6.0 also accepted.

aid.notes: SF State's Office of International Programs says there is no U.S. financial aid or international student scholarships to cover international students' studies at SF State. Applicants below the TOEFL/IELTS minimum may enroll in SF State's American Language Institute (intensive English; ali.sfsu.edu), which issues visa documents; the page does not call it conditional admission.

cost.notes: Computed from SF State's 2026-27 budget (on campus): tuition $6,838, mandatory fees $1,986, housing $18,270 plus food $5,620, books $1,100, transportation $1,566 plus personal $2,796 (loan fee $62 left out), plus the nonresident/international charge of $471 per unit for an assumed 30 units ($14,130). SF State's own on-campus total is $38,238 before that charge. International students must also buy health insurance (cost not found).
